name: @copilotkit/v2-migration
description: Codemod that migrates a CopilotKit app from v1 to 2.0. `npx copilotkit@latest migrate` runs it. Not published to npm or the Codemod registry.

scripts.test: codemod jssg test -l tsx ./scripts/codemod.ts ./tests/tsx && codemod jssg test -l typescript ./scripts/codemod.ts ./tests/ts && codemod jssg test -l html ./scripts/vue-sfc.ts ./tests/vue
